title: Creamy Italian Tartlets
description: A delicious Italian-inspired appetizer featuring creamy cheese filling in savory tartlets.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a mixing bowl, combine the cream cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread a small amount of the cheese mixture onto one half of each pastry circle.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the tartlets with a little water and sprinkle with parsley.
Place the tartlets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
